scenarios.name: Key-Value Store Reference Validation
scenarios.description: Verify the poem accurately references MirDB's key-value store nature (REQ-1)

steps.description: Load the complete poem text from the output location
steps.context: Poem must exist as deliverable output

steps.description: Search for explicit or metaphorical references to keys, values, pairs, or storage concepts
steps.context: References can be direct ('key-value') or metaphorical ('keeper of pairs', 'guardian of secrets')

steps.description: Confirm the key-value concept is represented correctly without false claims
steps.context: Must align with MirDB's actual functionality as a persistent key-value store

test_cases.expected: Contains at least one reference to key-value storage concept (explicit or metaphorical)
References are technically accurate and do not misrepresent functionality

scenarios.name: Data Persistence Theme Validation
scenarios.description: Verify the poem conveys the concept of data persistence and durability (REQ-2)

steps.description: Identify language that conveys durability, permanence, or data survival
steps.context: Themes like 'eternal records', 'memory that never fades' are expected

steps.description: Verify poem distinguishes persistent storage from volatile caching
steps.context: MirDB differs from memcached by offering persistence

test_cases.expected: Contains themes of permanence, durability, or eternal storage
Conveys that data survives beyond temporary memory (disk persistence)

scenarios.name: LSM-Tree Architecture Metaphor Validation
scenarios.description: Verify the poem metaphorically represents the LSM-tree architecture (REQ-3)

steps.description: Look for metaphors about layers, cascading, levels, or hierarchical organization
steps.context: LSM-tree has multiple levels from memtable through SSTable levels

steps.description: Verify references to data flowing from memory to disk in stages
steps.context: Data flows: Write -> WAL -> Memtable -> Imm Memtable -> Level 0 -> Level N SSTables

steps.description: Look for metaphors about refinement, distillation, or organization
steps.context: Compaction is the process of merging and organizing SSTables

test_cases.expected: Contains metaphorical representation of layered/hierarchical data structure
At least one LSM component (memtable, SSTable, compaction, WAL) is metaphorically referenced

scenarios.name: Rust Implementation Highlight Validation
scenarios.description: Verify the poem highlights the Rust implementation emphasizing strength and safety (REQ-4)

steps.description: Look for direct mention of Rust or metaphorical references to its qualities
steps.context: References like 'forged in fire', 'rust-resistant', 'unbreakable' are suggested

steps.description: Check for themes of safety, reliability, and performance that align with Rust's benefits
steps.context: Rust is known for memory safety, performance, and reliability

test_cases.expected: Contains reference to Rust language or its qualities (strength, safety, performance)
Imagery correctly associates Rust with positive attributes (not corrosion/decay)

scenarios.name: Reliability and Performance Theme Validation
scenarios.description: Verify the poem evokes themes of reliability and performance (REQ-6)

steps.description: Look for language about trustworthiness, dependability, and consistency
steps.context: MirDB is designed to be reliable through WAL and persistence

steps.description: Look for language about speed, efficiency, and responsiveness
steps.context: Skip list memtable and optimized reads provide performance

test_cases.expected: Contains themes of reliability, trust, or dependability
Contains themes of speed, efficiency, or performance

scenarios.name: Poem Length Requirement Validation
scenarios.description: Verify the poem is between 12-24 lines for optimal readability (REQ-7)

steps.description: Count the total number of lines in the poem (excluding empty lines)
steps.context: Empty lines for stanza breaks should not count toward line total

steps.description: Verify line count is between 12 and 24 inclusive
steps.context: This range optimizes readability and recitability

test_cases.expected: Line count >= 12
Line count <= 24

steps.context: Avoid overly complex or obscure references

scenarios.name: Technical Accuracy Review
scenarios.description: Comprehensive validation that all technical claims in the poem are accurate (Story 2)

steps.description: List all explicit and implied technical claims in the poem
steps.context: Metaphors should map correctly to real functionality

steps.description: Verify each claim against actual MirDB capabilities
steps.context: Reference MirDB documentation and knowledge base

steps.description: Check for any implied capabilities that MirDB doesn't have
steps.context: E.g., distributed operation via Raft is planned but not implemented

test_cases.input: Technical claims mapped to MirDB features
test_cases.expected: 100% of technical claims are accurate or correctly metaphorical
No false or unimplemented capabilities are implied

scenarios.name: Recitation Time Validation
scenarios.description: Verify the poem can be recited in under 2 minutes (Story 4)

steps.description: Estimate recitation time based on word count and complexity
steps.context: Average recitation pace is ~120-150 words per minute with pauses

steps.description: Time a spoken recitation of the poem at natural pace
steps.context: Include appropriate dramatic pauses for stanza breaks

test_cases.expected: Word count allows for recitation under 2 minutes (roughly < 300 words)
Actual recitation time is under 120 seconds

scenarios.name: LSM Component Coverage
scenarios.description: Validate coverage of specific LSM-tree components in poetic metaphors

steps.description: Look for Write-Ahead Log metaphor (safety net, promise keeper)
steps.context: WAL provides durability guarantee before data commits

steps.description: Look for memtable metaphor (swift thoughts, active mind)
steps.context: Memtable is the active in-memory skip list

steps.description: Look for SSTable metaphor (ancient tablets, sorted scrolls)
steps.context: SSTables are the persistent sorted storage files

steps.description: Look for compaction metaphor (refinement, distillation)
steps.context: Compaction merges and organizes data across levels

test_cases.expected: At least 2 distinct LSM components are metaphorically referenced
All LSM metaphors correctly represent their technical function

steps.description: Look for references to building, crafting, forging
steps.context: Craftsmanship themes emphasize quality engineering

steps.description: Ensure no obscure references, unprofessional humor, or exaggerated claims
steps.context: Avoid elements that would harm professional perception

test_cases.expected: Contains appropriate nature-based metaphors (trees, layers, flow)
Contains themes of building, crafting, or engineering excellence
No obscure references, inappropriate humor, or exaggerated claims present
